description: Source code for ucode-based scripting within hostapd, including VM creation, script execution, registry management, and utility functions.

methods.name: uc_gc_timer
methods.description: Callback for garbage collection timer, triggers garbage collection on VM.

methods.name: uc_wpa_printf
methods.description: Logs a message with specified level.

methods.name: uc_wpa_freq_info
methods.description: Provides frequency and channel info based on input parameters.

methods.name: uc_wpa_sha1
methods.description: Computes SHA1 hash of input strings.

methods.name: wpa_ucode_create_vm
methods.description: Initializes and returns a new ucode VM instance.

methods.name: wpa_ucode_run
methods.description: Loads and executes a ucode script, setting up registry.

methods.name: wpa_ucode_call_prepare
methods.description: Prepares VM stack for calling a function by name.

methods.name: wpa_ucode_global_init
methods.description: Initializes global object with constants and registers it.

methods.name: wpa_ucode_registry_add
methods.description: Adds a value to the registry array.

methods.name: wpa_ucode_registry_get
methods.description: Retrieves a value from the registry by index.

methods.name: wpa_ucode_registry_remove
methods.description: Removes a value from the registry by index.

methods.name: wpa_ucode_call
methods.description: Calls a function in the VM with specified arguments.

methods.name: wpa_ucode_free_vm
methods.description: Frees resources associated with the VM.
